words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ domin（主导）→ 排在最前面的主导 → 占主导地位的
words.origin: 拉丁语 praedominari：prae-（在前）+ dominari（统治）
words.native_definition: more important or noticeable than anything else in a group
words.core_concept: standing out in front as the master does – 像主人那样排在最前、压住全场
words.core_image: 整片山坡上就数那棵巨杉最高最粗，远远先看见它
examples: The predominant color is blue.
Agriculture is the predominant industry.
semantic_expansions: 占主导/显著：排在最前、最先被注意到的那一个
words.recall_hint: pre-（在前）+ domin（主导）→ 排在最前的主导

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ spect（看）→ 朝外看的那个念头 → 期待
words.origin: 拉丁语 exspectatio：ex-（向外）+ spectare（看）
words.native_definition: a strong belief that something will happen
words.core_concept: what one looks outward for – 朝外看去、等着它出现的东西
words.core_image: 站台边不停望向列车来的方向，心里早演好了那班车的样子
examples: She has high expectations of her students.
Sales met our expectations.
semantic_expansions: 期待/预期：朝外看等着它出现
指望：对他人表现设定的标准
words.recall_hint: ex-（向外）+ spect（看）→ 朝外看、等它出现 → 期待

words.root_logic: im-（in- 向内）+ port（携带）→ 被携带进来的分量 → 重要
words.origin: 拉丁语 importare（带入）的名词化——被带入的分量
words.native_definition: the quality of being significant or having great value
words.core_concept: weight carried into the matter – 被带进事情里的分量
words.core_image: 信封上那行字，落款人是谁，掂一下就知道轻重
examples: He stressed the importance of teamwork.
The discovery is of great importance.
semantic_expansions: 重要性：被带进事情的重量
words.recall_hint: im-（向内）+ port（携带）→ 带进来的分量 → 重要

words.root_logic: port（携带）+ -er（人）→ 帮着搬东西的人 → 搬运工
words.origin: 拉丁语 portare（携带）+ -or（者）
words.native_definition: a person whose job is carrying luggage or goods
words.core_concept: the one who carries things – 专管搬运的那个人
words.core_image: 站台上推着行李车快步走的人，旅客的大箱小包都在他车上
examples: The porter carried our bags to the room.
A hotel porter opened the door.
semantic_expansions: 搬运工：专管搬运的人
门房：看门并帮提行李的人
words.recall_hint: port（携带）+ -er → 搬东西的人

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ ced（行走）→ 走在前面的 → 前述的
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecedere：prae-（在前）+ cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: coming before something in time or order
words.core_concept: the one that goes in front – 走在前面、先到的那个
words.core_image: 翻回上一页，那行结论还在纸面上等着
examples: The preceding chapter explains the theory.
See the preceding paragraph.
semantic_expansions: 在前的/前述的：走在前面的那一个
words.recall_hint: pre-（在前）+ ced（行走）→ 走在前面的

words.root_logic: prefer（更喜欢）+ -able（可）→ 更可取、更该选的
words.origin: prefer 的形容词：prae-（在前）+ ferre（带）
words.native_definition: better or more suitable, especially compared to others
words.core_concept: the one worth carrying out in front – 更值得拿到前面来的
words.core_image: 两杯水摆着，一杯带冰一杯温的，天热时手自然伸向那杯冰的
examples: Walking is preferable to driving.
A quiet room is preferable.
semantic_expansions: 更可取：更值得拿到前面来的
words.recall_hint: prefer（更喜欢）+ -able → 更该选的

words.root_logic: cor-（相互）+ respond（回应）→ 彼此应得上的 → 相应的
words.origin: correspond 的形容词：com-（一起）+ respondere（回应）
words.native_definition: matching or connected with something else
words.core_concept: each answering to the other – 两边彼此应得上
words.core_image: 名单和座位号一一对好，拿号找座，一个都不落
examples: Sales rose, and profits showed a corresponding increase.
Fill in the corresponding boxes.
semantic_expansions: 相应/对应：两边彼此应得上
words.recall_hint: cor-（相互）+ respond（回应）→ 彼此应得上 → 相应的

words.root_logic: result（结果）+ -ant（…的）→ 作为结果而出现的
words.origin: result 的形容词：re-（回）+ salire（跳）
words.native_definition: happening as a result of something
words.core_concept: what leaps back out as the outcome – 事后蹦出来的那个结果
words.core_image: 比赛终场哨响，比分板上最终停下的那个数字
examples: The resultant damage was extensive.
Floods and the resultant chaos delayed us.
semantic_expansions: 作为结果：事后蹦出来的那个
words.recall_hint: result（结果）+ -ant → 作为结果出现的

words.root_logic: at-（ad- 朝向）+ tract（拉）→ 能把人拉过去的 → 有吸引力的
words.origin: 拉丁语 attrahere（拉近）：ad-（朝向）+ trahere（拉）
words.native_definition: pleasant to look at or pleasing to the mind
words.core_concept: pulling the eye toward it – 能把目光拉过去
words.core_image: 橱窗里那件展品，路过的人都会放慢脚步多看两眼
examples: The offer is very attractive.
She has an attractive smile.
semantic_expansions: 有吸引力：能把目光或兴趣拉过来
words.recall_hint: at-（朝向）+ tract（拉）→ 拉人过来的 → 有吸引力

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 朝向）+ cord（心）→ 心朝向同一个地方 → 一致
words.origin: 拉丁语 accordare（使同心）：ad-（朝向）+ cor/cordis（心）
words.native_definition: agreement or harmony between people; to be in agreement
words.core_concept: hearts turning toward the same point – 心朝向同一处
words.core_image: 两个人相视一点头，不用多说就知道想到一块去了
examples: The two sides reached an accord.
They acted in accord with the rules.
semantic_expansions: 一致：心朝向同一处
给予：把这份一致当作认可送出
条约：国与国达成的协定
words.recall_hint: ac-（朝向）+ cord（心）→ 心朝同一处 → 一致

words.root_logic: accord（一致）+ -ance → 一致的状态；常作 in accordance with（依照）
words.origin: accord 的名词化
words.native_definition: agreement or conformity; following a rule
words.core_concept: being in tune with the same heart – 与同一颗心合拍
words.core_image: 照着图纸一比一施工，每一个尺寸都对得上图纸
examples: The work was done in accordance with the plan.
in accordance with the law
semantic_expansions: 依照：与规定保持一致
words.recall_hint: accord（一致）+ -ance → 一致的进行

words.root_logic: according（一致）+ -ly → 与之相应地去办
words.origin: accord 的副词形式
words.native_definition: in a way that matches what was just said
words.core_concept: acting in line with the same tune – 顺着同一口径去办
words.core_image: 听到最新安排，马上把手里的计划照新口径改了
examples: The rules have changed, and we must act accordingly.
He was told the news and behaved accordingly.
semantic_expansions: 相应：照一致的标准去办
words.recall_hint: according（一致）+ -ly → 与之相应

words.root_logic: de-（向下）+ feat（做）→ 把对方做出来的局面压下去 → 击败
words.origin: 古法语 desfait：des-（去除）+ faire（做）；词根 facere（做）
words.native_definition: to win against someone; a failure to win
words.core_concept: undoing what the other side has done – 把对方做成的局面拆掉
words.core_image: 棋局最后一手落下，对方的布局被彻底拆解
examples: The team defeated its rival.
They suffered a heavy defeat.
semantic_expansions: 击败：把对方做成的事压下去
失败（名词）：被打败的结果
words.recall_hint: de-（向下）+ feat（做）→ 压掉对方所做的 → 击败

words.root_logic: feat（做）→ 做出来的不寻常之事 → 功绩
words.origin: 古法语 fait：facere（做）的过去分词
words.native_definition: an achievement that needs great skill or strength
words.core_concept: a deed that is done with skill – 做得漂亮、做得出众的事
words.core_image: 杂技演员走完高空钢索，全场屏住的那口气终于呼出
examples: The bridge is a feat of engineering.
Climbing the peak was quite a feat.
semantic_expansions: 功绩：做出众的事情
words.recall_hint: feat（做）→ 做得出众的事

words.root_logic: feat（做）+ -ure → 做出来摆给看的东西 → 特征、专题
words.origin: 古法语 faiture（制作）：facere（做）
words.native_definition: a distinctive part or quality; to include as important
words.core_concept: what is made to stand out – 特意做出来让人注意的那部分
words.core_image: 一张脸上最抓人的那双眼睛，或杂志封面主推的那篇报道
examples: The phone has many new features.
The film features a young actor.
semantic_expansions: 特征：做出来让人注意的部分
以…为特色：把某物做成主打
words.recall_hint: feat（做）+ -ure → 做出来让人注意的

words.root_logic: prob（检验）+ -ability → 检验得出的可能性大小 → 概率
words.origin: 拉丁语 probabilitas：probare（检验、证实）
words.native_definition: how likely something is to happen; chance
words.core_concept: the measured likelihood after testing – 检验之后得出的可能程度
words.core_image: 抛一百次硬币，正面朝上的次数大致各半，心里就有数了
examples: There is a high probability of rain.
The probability of failure is low.
semantic_expansions: 概率：检验得出的可能程度
words.recall_hint: prob（检验）+ -ability → 检验出的可能程度

words.root_logic: prob（检验）+ -able → 经检验很可能的 → 很可能的
words.origin: 拉丁语 probabilis：probare（检验）
words.native_definition: likely to happen or be true
words.core_concept: passing the test of likelihood – 经得起'很可能'检验的
words.core_image: 看着天上堆起来的乌云，心里判断这场雨八九成要下
examples: It is probable that he will come.
A probable cause of the delay is traffic.
semantic_expansions: 很可能：经得起可能性的检验
words.recall_hint: prob（检验）+ -able → 很可能的

words.root_logic: prob（检验）→ 伸进去验一验里面是什么 → 探查；试探
words.origin: 拉丁语 probare（检验）的名词形式
words.native_definition: a thorough investigation; to examine closely
words.core_concept: testing what lies inside – 伸进去验一验里面是什么
words.core_image: 医生轻轻试探伤口深浅，先弄清伤到哪一层，才敢判断
examples: The committee probed into the scandal.
A space probe explored the planet.
semantic_expansions: 探查：伸进去检验里面
探针：探查用的工具
words.recall_hint: prob（检验）→ 伸进去验 → 探查

words.root_logic: re-（相反）+ sist（站立）→ 立住不动地顶回去 → 抵抗
words.origin: 拉丁语 resistere：re-（相反）+ sistere（站立）；sistere 与 stare 同源
words.native_definition: to fight against something; to refuse to accept
words.core_concept: standing firm against the push – 顶着来势立住不退
words.core_image: 逆风里迈步，每一步都顶着风，人被往后推也不退
examples: They resisted the invasion.
She couldn't resist the chocolate.
semantic_expansions: 抵抗：顶着来势立住
忍住：抵御诱惑不随它走
words.recall_hint: re-（相反）+ sist（立）→ 顶着立住 → 抵抗

words.root_logic: resist（抵抗）+ -ance → 抵抗的状态或力量
words.origin: resistere 的名词化
words.native_definition: the act of fighting against something; a force opposing movement
words.core_concept: the standing firm against a push – 顶着来势立住的那股劲
words.core_image: 河道里竖起的石墩，水流冲过来，被它分开绕行
examples: The army met strong resistance.
Copper has low electrical resistance.
semantic_expansions: 抵抗：顶着来的状态
阻力：阻碍运动的力
words.recall_hint: resist（抵抗）+ -ance → 顶着的力

words.root_logic: resist（抵抗）+ -ant → 能顶住而不被改变的
words.origin: resistere 的形容词
words.native_definition: not affected or harmed by something
words.core_concept: standing firm and unyielding – 立住不被动摇
words.core_image: 刷了防水层的木船，泡在水里也不烂不渗
examples: The material is resistant to heat.
Some insects are resistant to pesticides.
semantic_expansions: 抗…的：立住不被改变
words.recall_hint: resist（抵抗）+ -ant → 能顶住的

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ stitut（立）+ -e → 一起立起来组成 → 构成
words.origin: 拉丁语 constituere：com-（一起）+ statuere（立）；statuere 与 stare 同源
words.native_definition: to form or make up something
words.core_concept: standing together to form a whole – 一起立起来拼成整体
words.core_image: 几块木板拼在一起立起来，就成了一个架子
examples: Women constitute half of the workforce.
Such actions constitute a crime.
semantic_expansions: 构成：一起立起来组成整体
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ stitut（立）→ 立起来组成 → 构成

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ stitut（立）→ 立起来使其开始运行 → 建立
words.origin: 拉丁语 instituere：in-（进入）+ statuere（立）
words.native_definition: an organization for a purpose; to set up
words.core_concept: setting something standing so it runs – 立起来让它运转
words.core_image: 把一所学校立起来，先立规矩再招生，从此年年有人进来
examples: She works at a research institute.
They instituted new safety rules.
semantic_expansions: 机构：立起来运转的组织
建立：立起让它开始运转
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ stitut（立）→ 立起来运转 → 建立

words.root_logic: sub-（在下）+ stitut（立）→ 站在下面顶替 → 替代
words.origin: 拉丁语 substituere：sub-（在下）+ statuere（立）
words.native_definition: a person or thing used instead of another; to replace
words.core_concept: one standing in below to take the place – 立在底下顶替的那个
words.core_image: 主力球员受伤下场，替补换上，位置照样有人顶住
examples: Honey can substitute for sugar.
He came on as a substitute.
semantic_expansions: 替代：站在下面顶替位置
words.recall_hint: sub-（在下）+ stitut（立）→ 站在下面顶替 → 替代

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ tin（握住）→ 连在一起握住的大陆 → 洲
words.origin: 拉丁语 continere（连在一起）：com-（一起）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: one of the large land masses of the Earth
words.core_concept: land held together in one continuous mass – 连成一片、握在一起的大陆
words.core_image: 从飞机上往下看，陆地的边界连成一大片，中间没有断
examples: Africa is a continent.
The five continents were once connected.
semantic_expansions: 大陆：连成一片、握在一起的地
洲：地球上连成整块的大陆
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ tin（握住）→ 连住的大陆

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ tin（握住）+ -ual → 一直握在一起不松 → 连续不断的
words.origin: 拉丁语 continuus：com-（一起）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: happening repeatedly without stopping
words.core_concept: held together without a break – 一直连着没断
words.core_image: 楼上装修的电钻声一阵接一阵，从早到晚没停过
examples: There was continual noise from the street.
Continual interruptions made work hard.
semantic_expansions: 连续：一直连着没断
频繁：隔不多久又来一次
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ tin（握）+ -ual → 一直连着

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ tin（握住）+ -uous → 不间断的
words.origin: continuus 的另一形容词形式
words.native_definition: happening without any pause or break
words.core_concept: held in one unbroken line – 一条线连到底
words.core_image: 那根水管里的水从早流到晚，中间没有一刻停
examples: The road has a continuous white line.
Continuous rain caused flooding.
semantic_expansions: 连续：一条线不断
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ tin（握）+ -uous → 不间断的

words.root_logic: station（站）+ -ery → 摆在书桌'站'的地方的用品 → 文具
words.origin: 拉丁语 statio（站立之处）；与 stare（站）同源
words.native_definition: materials for writing, such as paper and pens
words.core_concept: things that sit by the writing stand – 摆在书写之处的东西
words.core_image: 书桌角上一叠信纸、几支笔、一瓶墨水，写东西的家伙事都在
examples: The shop sells stationery and books.
She bought some stationery for school.
semantic_expansions: 文具：摆在书写之处的用品
words.recall_hint: station（站）+ -ery → 摆在书桌边的文具

words.root_logic: statist（统计）+ -ical → 与统计有关的
words.origin: statistic ← 德语 Statistik ← 拉丁语 status（状况，站着的情形）；与 stare 同源
words.native_definition: relating to statistics or numbers that describe data
words.core_concept: about the standing facts counted up – 把站着的实况数出来
words.core_image: 那叠问卷上的勾选被一个个数出来，折成百分比画成图
examples: Statistical analysis supports the finding.
The data show a statistical increase.
semantic_expansions: 统计的：把实况数出来
words.recall_hint: stat（站）+ -istical → 把实况数出来

words.root_logic: sta（站立）→ 立住不动 → 停留
words.origin: 古法语 ester / rester：拉丁语 stare（站立）
words.native_definition: to remain in one place; a period of remaining
words.core_concept: standing in place, not moving off – 立在那儿不挪动
words.core_image: 逛到街角那家店就站住了，这一站就是一下午
examples: Please stay here until I return.
They stayed at a hotel for two nights.
semantic_expansions: 停留：立住不动
暂住：在一处住下不动
保持：维持在某种状态不离开
words.recall_hint: sta（站立）→ 立住不动 → 停留
